baseline_models.focus_anchor: The entire ayah is three separately written and recited letter-names, عٓ سٓ قٓ, with no rooted morpheme, lexical word, or syntactic relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Graphic compactness expands into a measured three-beat utterance while lexical parsing is suspended; the form marks a threshold by controlled segmentation rather than by proposition.

changed_reading.before: An opaque cluster awaiting a lexical solution.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately segmented sonic-graphic threshold whose first function is to arrest ordinary parsing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first names revelation directly after the letter-only opening, then closes by distinguishing intelligible speech from revelation, concealment, and messenger-mediated delivery. The audible but nonpropositional letters enact a channel in which something arrives while lexical content remains screened.

activation_trace.role: Hidden imparting makes semantic concealment compatible with genuine transmission and recasts the opener as a delivered but screened event.
The hidden-sound image fits letter-names that are fully audible yet do not yield an ordinary proposition.
Intelligible utterance connecting speakers supplies the contrast against which the opener's voiced but nonlexical form becomes functional.
The repeated hidden-imparting channel permits communication without direct lexical speech.
Messenger and message separate transported content from an unmediated speaker-hearer connection.
Placement behind visibility supplies the spatial screen that the opener's present-but-unparsed letters formally resemble.
A concealing barrier makes partial access, rather than failed access, the governing mechanism.
The closing return to hidden imparting completes the frame opened immediately after 42:2.

structural_cues: 42:1 and 42:2 are consecutive rootless letter-only ayahs immediately followed by كَذَٰلِكَ يُوحِي in 42:3.
42:51 enumerates revelation, speech behind a veil, and a sent messenger; 42:52 resumes وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا, bracketing the surah with the same deictic-revelation construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden imparting, hidden sound, intelligible speech, concealment, veil, and message; I infer that 42:2 performs a screened channel in which audible signs arrive while propositional content stays withheld. A live alternative is that the letters are only a conventional opener and كَذَٰلِكَ points generically rather than back to them.

changed_reading.before: A cryptic preface standing outside the surah's communicative argument.
changed_reading.after: A performative specimen of veiled revelation: reception is real, but direct lexical access is withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reading gathers, writing orders letters, and divisions regulate discourse. The three focus letters remain visibly separate while recitation binds them into one ayah, making the opener a miniature of textual assembly that preserves its component boundaries.

activation_trace.role: Gathering supplies the operation by which three detached units become one recited event.
Reading and recitation make the audible sequencing of otherwise separate glyphs textually productive.
The ordering of letters and the written product give the focus sequence a material assembly mechanism.
Divisions and components that regulate speech explain why separation can structure a whole instead of merely fragmenting it.
The closing return to the written product lets the opening letter-parts anticipate the book without encoding its contents.

structural_cues: 42:2 presents three discrete graphic units as one ayah, while 42:7 identifies the revealed discourse as an Arabic Qur'an.
The focus has neither lexical joining nor punctuation between propositions; its only evident organization is ordered adjacency and recitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering/recitation, ordered letters, and discourse-regulating divisions; I infer that the opener stages assembly-with-boundaries at the smallest textual scale. The alternative is a simple list of letter-names with no iconic relation to the later book.

changed_reading.before: Three disconnected pieces that fail to form a word.
changed_reading.after: A micro-model of scripture: distinct letter-parts are gathered by ordered recitation without losing their separateness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly calls nonverbal created configurations visible signs. Since the rootless focus is itself an ayah and consists only of manifest marks and sounds, its function can be ostensive and attention-directing without requiring a recoverable lexical plaintext.

activation_trace.role: A manifest sign supplies a nonpropositional mode of significance for the visible focus letters.
A second visible-sign occurrence reinforces recognition and orientation rather than lexical decoding.
The repeated sign label across changing phenomena permits significance to reside in configuration and event.
Disputation around signs shows that a sign may provoke response before its import is settled.

structural_cues: The packet identifies 42:2 as an ayah even though it has no rooted morphemes.
42:29, 42:32, 42:33, and 42:35 form a dense run of sign-language applied to created arrangements rather than ordinary sentences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated manifest signs; I infer that the focus ayah may operate by presence, arrest, and orientation rather than as a cipher. A live alternative is that these later signs do not define the function of the opening letters.

changed_reading.before: A code whose value depends on discovering hidden lexical substitutions.
changed_reading.after: A manifest sign-event whose opacity redirects attention without licensing letter-by-letter decoding.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is unusually balanced between seen glyphs and heard letter-names. Revelation branches explicitly span inscription and hidden sound, while the surah pairs hearing and sight, activating the opener as a relay between visual marks and vocal reception.

activation_trace.role: Writing and inscription supply the visible pole embodied by the three isolated glyphs.
Hidden sound supplies the vocal pole embodied by pronouncing the glyphs as letter-names.
Auditory perception makes the recited expansion of the compact script a functional half of the form.
Visual perception makes the separated written marks, not only their sound, part of the mechanism.

structural_cues: Each compact written character in 42:2 is recited as a longer letter-name, so the ayah changes scale and modality in performance.
The hearing/sight pair occurs in the creation-and-revelation sequence of 42:11 rather than as an instruction to decode the letters.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inscription, hidden sound, hearing, and sight; I infer that the opener makes revelation's cross-modal transfer perceptible. The alternative is that the hearing and sight attributes are locally descriptive and do not activate the letter forms.

changed_reading.before: Either mute written symbols or unexplained recited sounds.
changed_reading.after: A cross-modal relay in which tiny visible marks unfold into heard names while remaining lexically unmerged.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Treating the three letters as a keyset is surprising because the packet never assigns a lock or value to an individual letter. It remains anchored in their discrete instrument-like form and in the exact maqālīd branch that preserves and opens what lies beneath; render it only as a functional analogy for opening access, never as a decoded key.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Three discrete signs stand at the surah's threshold and open onto a discourse whose contents are not lexically present in them.

activation_trace.role: Instruments that preserve and open what is beneath activate the letters as an opening interface rather than a container of the surah's propositions.

changed_reading.before: A locked object demanding that the reader crack it.
changed_reading.after: An exploratory keyset whose use is to open entry into the surah while withholding a one-to-one decoding.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The fertility-to-language transfer is odd, but the ع ق م inventory explicitly contains obscure barren speech, the focus has no lexical or rooted offspring, and 42:50 moves immediately into the speech taxonomy of 42:51. Carry this as a paradox of form, not as the meaning of ع, س, or ق and not as a claim that revelation is sterile.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus produces no word, root, clause, or proposition, yet it heads and releases a complete discourse.

activation_trace.role: Obscure barren speech directly activates the focus's nonlexical opacity as a kind of formal infertility.
Intelligible speech connecting speakers supplies the fertile lexical contrast immediately after the barrenness taxonomy.
Hidden imparting explains how a lexically barren threshold can nevertheless generate reception and guidance.

changed_reading.before: A failed or sterile fragment because it generates no lexical sense.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately barren lexical form that is paradoxically generative as the threshold of the surah's discourse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation uses a branch distant from the surface sense of وراء and is therefore deliberately strange. It remains traceable because latent fire, concealment, veil, and ensuing light occur in the closing communication sequence, while the compact opening marks can formally serve as ignition points; qualify it as a material analogy, not hidden letter symbolism.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Three compact, apparently inert marks precede the surah's full semantic unfolding.

activation_trace.role: Latent fire emerging from a struck stone supplies the ignition image for meaning released from compact marks.
The concealing barrier keeps the latent content screened at the moment of contact.
Illumination supplies the disclosed state into which the opener's latent spark can unfold.

changed_reading.before: Cold marks with no semantic activity.
changed_reading.after: Exploratory latent sparks whose contact initiates an unfolding from screened communication into light.

strongest_changes: The deictic revelation frame recasts the rootless letters as an enacted, screened communication channel.
Gathering/recitation, ordered letters, and regulated divisions turn separateness into a micro-model of textual assembly.
The repeated manifest-sign branch permits significance without a recoverable lexical cipher.
The closing barren-speech branch exposes a contained paradox: lexical infertility can still be discourse-generative.
summary.what_was_special: Because 42:2 is wholly rootless, context could not responsibly assign semantic values to individual letters. Its strongest activations were instead formal: segmentation, assembly, visual-to-auditory transfer, screening, and nonpropositional signhood, with the end-of-surah communication sequence looping sharply back to the opening.
remaining_uncertainties: It is uncertain whether the كَذَٰلِكَ of 42:3 points specifically back to the two letter-only ayahs or only names revelation's recurring manner.
The sign model does not establish whether the letters have additional conventional meanings unavailable in the packet.
The keyset, barren-speech, and latent-fire readings are branch-driven analogies and must not be rendered as letter-by-letter decoding.
No packet evidence assigns separate semantic values to ع, س, and ق.
